items.title: Stablecoin Drain, ETF Outflows Leave Bitcoin 'Running on Empty'
items.summary: Stablecoin supply fell $14.2 billion in 30 days, the fastest contraction since June 2022, amid weak ETF demand.

items.title: SoFi Brings Its Bank-Issued Stablecoin to Polygon’s Payments Stack
items.summary: SoFiUSD, the first stablecoin from a U.S. national bank, is now live on Polygon Open Money Stack alongside Ethereum and Solana.

items.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
items.summary: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.

items.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
items.summary: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

items.title: BitGo expands institutional stablecoin minting and redemption platform with USDC
items.summary: BitGo's institutional clients can now mint and redeem USDC through Go Accounts, with orders handled through its Circle Mint account.
